content.value_statement: Neuropixels workflows require many specialized preprocessing, sorting, curation, and reporting steps. This skill provides structured SpikeInterface-based guidance, scripts, and review checklists for reproducible neural recording analysis.
actual_capabilities: Loads SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, and NWB recording formats through SpikeInterface examples.
Guides preprocessing with filtering, phase shift, bad channel removal, and common reference.
Documents motion correction choices for rigid and non-rigid Neuropixels drift.
Runs spike sorting workflows for Kilosort4 and CPU alternatives.
Computes quality metrics and applies Allen, IBL, or strict curation criteria.
Creates reports, plots, Phy exports, and optional AI-assisted unit review.
limitations: Requires local scientific Python packages and compatible spike sorting software.
Kilosort4 workflows need a supported GPU for practical performance.
Automated curation is a starting point and still needs expert review.
AI-assisted review may send derived plots to an external model provider.

use_cases.title: Process New Probe Recordings
use_cases.description: Plan the full path from raw SpikeGLX data to curated units and summary reports.

use_cases.title: Standardize Lab Pipelines
use_cases.description: Apply consistent preprocessing, drift correction, sorting, and quality metric thresholds across experiments.

use_cases.title: Review Borderline Units
use_cases.description: Compare automated labels with waveform, correlogram, firing rate, and optional AI-assisted visual review.

prompt_templates.title: Load a Recording
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner inspection of a raw data folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use neuropixels-analysis to inspect my SpikeGLX folder at [path]. Show streams, probe metadata, duration, and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Preprocess and Check Drift
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a preprocessing plan for my Neuropixels 1.0 data. Include filtering, phase shift, bad channels, common reference, and drift checks.

prompt_templates.title: Run Sorting and Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Kilosort4 workflow for this recording. Include output folders, quality metrics, Allen curation thresholds, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Advanced Curation
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these quality metrics and waveform plots. Compare Allen, IBL, strict, and AI-assisted curation decisions for uncertain units.

output_examples.input: A user asks how to start a Neuropixels SpikeGLX analysis.
output_examples.output: A staged workflow covering data inspection, preprocessing, drift estimation, spike sorting, metrics, curation, and report export.

output_examples.input: A lab has borderline units after Kilosort4.
output_examples.output: A curation review plan with metric thresholds, waveform checks, autocorrelogram review, and labels for good, multi-unit, or noise.
A plotting checklist for probe maps, drift maps, firing rates, waveforms, correlograms, and quality metric summaries.

best_practices: Start with a short recording slice before processing a full session.
Visualize drift and probe geometry before selecting correction settings.
Review uncertain units manually before accepting automated labels.
anti_patterns: Running Kilosort4 without checking GPU availability and sorter dependencies.
Treating automated curation labels as final scientific conclusions.
Sharing neural plots with external AI providers without data approval.

faq.question: Does this skill include a complete analysis pipeline?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides workflow guidance and scripts for preprocessing, sorting, metrics, curation, plotting, and reports.

faq.question: Which recording formats are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, and NWB workflows through SpikeInterface readers.

faq.question: Can it run Kilosort4?
faq.answer: It documents Kilosort4 workflows and parameters. Your local environment must provide Kilosort4 and compatible GPU support.

faq.question: Does it replace manual curation?
faq.answer: No. It helps prioritize units and apply criteria, but expert review remains important.

faq.question: Can Claude or Codex inspect waveform plots?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for AI-assisted visual review of uncertain units and generated figures.

faq.question: Will it upload my data automatically?
faq.answer: No automatic upload was found. Optional AI-assisted review may use external provider clients when configured by the user.
